title: Remediation Result (one append to exec_log.jsonl)
description:
Versioned contract for a single exec_log.jsonl line — the implementer envelope: what ran, against which base commit, which files moved, and whether the metric improved. Written by api/src/reflex-engine.ts _appendExecLog (TypeScript) and read by bin/sensei_prep.py post-audit selection, the rival agent's causal check, remediation.py efficacy events, and skill_efficacy.py. Draft-07 is mandatory, not stylistic: ajv 6.15.0 (api/package.json) rejects 2020-12 outright while Python jsonschema 4.26 accepts it, so a 2020-12 schema passes the Python tests and silently fails on the TS side.

Only the four keys every real row carries are required. _appendExecLog writes two row FLAVOURS from one function — a manual (dashboard-clicked) row that deliberately omits `improved` so it never counts as a failure in skill_efficacy, and a full autonomous row — so anything absent from either flavour stays optional. Consumers already treat absence as 'not measured'; making those required would reclassify healthy historical rows as violations.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the run settled.

command.description: The canonical reflex command, e.g. /simplify. Kept verbatim (never with runtime args folded in) so dedup keys and this log agree.

skill.description: Bare skill word of the command ('/simplify --write x' -> 'simplify'). skill_efficacy.json keys on this.

status.description: Graded outcome. no_change = clean run, zero repo diff; timeout = the skill was working and didn't finish. Both are distinct from error for loop-breaker accounting.

source.description: Actor channel. Consumers attribute human-vs-autonomous via source !== 'reflex_engine' (remediation.py).

improved.description: True = the reflex resolved (metric moved past threshold). OMITTED on manual rows by contract — an explicit false there would wrongly lengthen the autonomous channel's cooldowns.

code_modifying.description: True when the skill has edit capabilities. This is the field the rival post-auditor selects on; legacy rows lacking it fall back to a files_changed-outside-state/ test.

read_only.description: Mechanism rows only — mirrors the mechanism's own read_only declaration.

fallback_from.description: Set when a mechanism attempt preceded (and lost to) this skill run. These rows also seed eval_corpus.jsonl.

harness_fingerprint.description: ATDP execution envelope: which harness version produced the trace. Absent on rows written before the field existed.

worker.description: package@version of the agent package that executed the run (A4). Identifies the worker, not just the harness surface — 'critic@1'. Absent on rows written before the field existed.

predicted_impact.description: Decision observability: the falsifiable prediction stated BEFORE the outcome was known. stated:false is the honest default and IS recorded — 'predicted nothing' is a measurement about the harness, not a missing field.

metric_before.description: Fire-time metric value. Omitted when unmeasurable (non-metric reflex, unreadable payload) — consumers treat absence as 'no measurement', so null is NOT a valid stand-in.

git_before_commit.description: Base commit the diff below is taken against. The rival post-auditor REFUSES to confirm an improved:true claim without it.

git_diff_summary.description: git diff --shortstat output, or null when git was unavailable at write time.
